summary: Held through 17 minutes of extreme whipsaw (repeated swings between roughly +32 and -26 pts) that kept fully recovering, treating it as noise/chop given low ER10 and giveback ratios under 50%. Bailed at t=17m when price broke to -65.5pts -- 2.5x worse than any prior extreme, on a strong directional 5s bar (closed near its low, clsInRng 0.95) with leg amplitude blowing out to 108.8pts and both HA and PROPP fire signals against, which read as a genuine momentum break rather than another mean-reverting swing. Next time I'd weight the magnitude jump relative to the established chop range more heavily and treat 2x+ breaks beyond the established range as an early bail trigger rather than waiting to see if it's 'just another swing.'
